title: Go and Make Disciples
ref: Matthew 28:18-20; 2 Timothy 2:2; Luke 10:1-12 ( Jesus Sends His Disciples)

sections.title: Look Back (Review)
paragraphs: Pray for one another: Thanksgiving and Requests
Sing a song of praise together
Review & Accountability
To whom did you tell Jesus’ story?
Have someone teach the “Hand Gospel”
What was the topic of the last lesson? What did you learn?
(Four Fields)

sections.title: Look Up (New Teaching)
paragraphs: Read
We have a responsibility to tell others about Jesus. How can we do this effectively? Let’s read God’s Word and do what it says.
Matthew 28:18-20
2 Timothy 2:2
Luke 10:1-12 ( Jesus Sends His Disciples)
Tell It as a Story
Can someone tell this story in their own words?
Practice in groups of two.
Teach
Jesus commands all who follow Him to go, make disciples and baptize. This is not an option.
We make disciples by teaching them to obey. Show them how to obey Him!
We should go to new places and look for people of peace.
If we go to a house and they are not interested in the Gospel, we should go to the next house.
If possible, travel two by two when you go to preach the Gospel.
Follow Paul’s example to teach others who will teach others who will teach others. This plan will cause many to be reached with the Gospel!
Ask
What did you learn from these Scriptures?
Think a little, how will you practice what you have learned?

sections.title: Look Forward (Obedience)
paragraphs: Make a Plan
Make a plan to go to a new village that does not know Jesus and look for people of peace.
If someone chooses to follow Jesus, then start teaching him or her how to tell Jesus’ story (the Gospel).
Take a believer with you as you go out so that they can learn.
To whom will you tell your testimony and Jesus’ story?
Vision Casting
Many people have never heard the Gospel and will never hear unless someone goes to them and tells them. Let’s commit to share the Gospel with them.
Romans 10:14-15
Pray
Ask God to show us where He wants us to do ministry. Ask Him to provide us with people of peace. Ask Him to prepare the hearts of those who will hear.
